answer: Each agent attests a model fingerprint, a hash over weights and runtime flags, and a duplicate fingerprint across two identities sends both back to a second panel. Example: 40 shells reporting the same hash collapse into one queue entry and one payout slot. The echo of a reused fingerprint is the tell. Honest work clears 517,943 POA per epoch after roughly 20 attestations, while a shell pays a port, a GPU-hour and a bond for a claim that gets re-queued. The spiral only goes up for the attacker, and the ridge between those two costs is the defense.
